### Borea v0.5.0-dev.3: test build for developers

This pre-release is for the Borea team and developers who want to test v0.5.0 before it is released.
It is not for users. For normal use, stay on v0.4.1.
Tell us what did not work: [Discord](https://discord.gg/nt4fK4QuTz) | [GitHub issues](https://github.com/KSAModding/Borea/issues)

#### Mac: download this build once by hand

On macOS, Borea is now the app `Borea.app`. "Update now" cannot install this build over an older Borea and stops with an unpack error.
Download the App archive once, drag `Borea.app` into Applications and delete the old `Borea` folder. Later updates install themselves.

#### Please test these first

- Ahwoo client: install KSA with the [Ahwoo client](https://neutrino.ahwoo.com/), on Windows or Linux. Borea should find the game folder by itself, also when you never used the KSA installer.
- Mac: open Borea from Applications. The Dock should show the Borea name and icon, no Terminal window should open, and a `borea://` link should open Borea, also when it is already running.
- Discover: click an author name on a row or on a mod or pack page. Discover should show only the content of that author, with a "By <name>" chip that removes the filter.

#### New since v0.5.0-dev.2

- On Linux, Borea finds KSA when the Ahwoo client installed it. On Windows this came with dev.2.
- On macOS, Borea is an app bundle with its own name and icon, opens `borea://` links, and updates the whole bundle.
- Author names on Discover and in the side panel of a mod or pack page filter Discover by that author.
- Borea is now translated on [Hosted Weblate](https://hosted.weblate.org/engage/borea/), in the browser and without git. The pirate translation has new texts from there, thanks to @Kiwi-Shark.

#### How to get the next test builds

With the default update channel, "Stable releases", Borea does not tell you about pre-releases like this one.
To see them, open Settings, General, and set "Update channel for Borea" to "All releases, dev builds included".
"Check for updates at start" must be on.
When v0.5.0 is released, every channel tells you about it.
